description: This file provides support for interfacing with OpenAI's chat completion endpoint within the DataRobot environment. It defines a configuration class, DataRobotConfig, that manages API key and URL resolution, ensuring compatibility with DataRobot's API and secret management system. The class includes methods for resolving API credentials and constructing the complete API URL for chat completions.

classes.name: DataRobotConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for DataRobot's OpenAI-like chat API integration, handling API key and URL resolution.

methods.name: str _resolve_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Returns a valid API key, prioritizing a user-provided key, secret manager, or defaulting to a fake key for testing purposes.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_api_base(api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Determines and constructs the API base URL, appending necessary paths based on the provided or secret-fetched value.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Returns the API base URL and API key, resolving fallback options if necessary.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full API URL for chat completions, based on the resolved API base URL.
